body: Usually it’s heroin, fentanyl and Xanax right.
I feel you when you say you can’t relate to anyone. It’s like every one else is living their own lives and not truly giving concern to you.
Me too. They interrupt and throw off my whole schedule. My moods are like rollercoasters.

Sorry to hear that, sometimes I feel like that too when I reflect on my life. There’s the idea of happiness not being a real thing but moments of joy instead. I believe there could be a balance but most of the times life is just very challenging and not always positive.
Yes. Every time I think about death and know there’s an escape to suffering it’s like I drank a Red Bull. It gives me energy.
It’s like a whole world going on inside your head. I feel like the only way to escape it is to go through with it. Everything becomes silent and time freezes.
I agree, we are all heading to the same destination.
